Subject: Tenant invoice buckets & VAT triage for Ember Health

Hi Ari / Ember finance,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As we move toward the Aug billing run we want to confirm how Ember wants the invoice to be emitted when a single Redwood invoice needs to be split across multiple Ember tenants / cost centers and when VAT should be applied per-tenant vs at the legal entity level.

Attached is a lightweight template (invoice_bucket_template.xlsx) that shows the split line items we normally emit: invoice row, amount, tenant id, cost center code, remit instructions, and tax flag. Before we lock this for production we need to confirm three things from your side:

- How should VAT be calculated when a single purchase covers seats across multiple jurisdictions? (per-tenant VAT flag or single VAT line)
- Preferred cost center mapping field (tenant_id vs project_code) for your ERP ingest
- Any remit address or remit-to entity changes we should include per bucket

Proposed next steps:
1) Ember confirms the mapping and VAT preference in reply
2) We update the template and send a DocuSign for the signed remit/PO acknowledgment (if needed)
3) Small test invoice during the Aug 1 billing cycle to validate ingest

Can you confirm by EOD Tue (23 Jul) if possible? If preferred, we can do a 30-min call next week to walk the template.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Sr. Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_bucket_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Ari Bell <ari.bell@emberhealth.com>

Cc: Finance Ops <payments@emberhealth.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@emberhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 11:02:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant invoice buckets & VAT triage for Ember Health

Connor — thanks for sending this over and for the clear template. Looping in our payments team so we're all aligned. Quick answers from Ember side:

- VAT: we need VAT applied per legal entity. Ember has two VAT registrations (UK and DE) that might touch different tenant groups. So if a tenant is assigned to a VAT-registered entity, please emit the VAT on that bucket.
- Cost center mapping: prefer project_code for our ERP (NetLedger). We can map tenant_id -> project_code on our side but if Redwood can populate project_code on the split rows that reduces manual work.
- Remit: most remit should go to Ember Global Ltd (UK) except for a small set of German customers that should be routed to Ember GmbH. I attached our W9-equivalent and tax ids for the remit mapping.

Also: we have a sample file naming convention for multi-entity invoices — see payments@emberhealth.com standard. Our ops person (Daniel) will own the test ingest and can coordinate the test invoice date.

Ari Bell
Head of Finance Operations
Ember Health

Thanks Ari — this is helpful. Internal notes / proposal from revenue ops & billing: 

- We will extend the split row to include project_code (string) and vat_registration_id so you don't need to backfill.
- For VAT logic: Redwood will evaluate VAT at the bucket level. If a bucket includes a tenant mapped to a VAT-registered entity, we will emit two rows: taxable_amount and vat_amount for that bucket. Otherwise vat_amount is 0.
- Remit routing: we will add remit_entity and remit_address fields per split row; defaults set to Ember Global Ltd unless explicit tenant->entity override exists.

Action items for Ben/Connor:
- Ben: produce a short mapping table (tenant_id -> project_code, remit_entity override) and share in the Drive.
- Connor: prepare a test invoice for Aug 1 with three buckets (UK VAT, DE VAT, non-VAT) and share ingestion instructions with Daniel.

I put a draft mapping sheet here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-ember-invoice-buckets — please add your columns and examples.

Kimberly Park
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick summary and next steps so we have a written record: 

Summary of agreed approach:
- Redwood will emit split invoice rows that include: invoice_row_id, amount, tenant_id, project_code, remit_entity, remit_address, vat_registration_id, taxable_amount, vat_amount.
- VAT is calculated at the bucket level; taxable and VAT amounts will be present when the bucket maps to a VAT-registered Ember legal entity.
- Default remit_entity is Ember Global Ltd (UK) unless Daniel provides tenant-level overrides.

Immediate next steps (by Aug 1 test):
1) Ember (Daniel) to populate tenant_id -> project_code and remit overrides in the shared Drive sheet by Wed, Jul 24.
2) Redwood (Ben) to prepare test invoice and provide a sample ingest CSV and a one-page ingestion note.
3) Connor to send DocuSign for the updated remit/PO acknowledgment if Ember requires signature on the split remit rules. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/link/EMBR-INV-BUCKETS-2028

If that timeline works I'll schedule a 30-min run-through on Tue Jul 25. Otherwise reply with availability.

Connor O'Brien
